name: sports-event-management
description: Enterprise Sports Event Management (SEM) Platform for scheduling, live-scoring, and real-time tournament brackets.
author: Sports Event Management Team

scripts.start: npx -y concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix sem-backend run lint && npx prettier --check "sem-frontend/src/**/*.{ts,html,css}"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix sem-backend run build --if-present && npx tsc --noEmit -p sem-frontend/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.test: npm --prefix sem-backend test -- --passWithNoTests && npm --prefix sem-frontend test -- --run --passWithNoTests
